summary: The local party needs drivers to take people to vote and workers outside to check its lists.
realLife: Peters distinguished Kanawha’s paid party workers from the officials administering the election inside.
gates: Election-day party work is permitted and scheduled.
inGame: needs: a volunteer driving roster and fulfilled ride requests distinct from election administration.

turns.what: A driver takes the morning requests and hands the afternoon list to dispatch.
turns.pulledBy: The driver's paid shift starts at noon.

turns.what: The rostered driver spends the morning waiting at headquarters.
turns.pulledBy: Everyone who booked a ride calls to say they have transportation.
turns.writesBack: The log shows canceled requests and no completed trips.
